validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="cart"><items/></data>
    <data id="total" expr="0"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <assign location="$cart/items" type="addattribute" expr="'x'"/>
      <assign location="$cart/items" attr="count" expr="1"/>
      <assign location="$total"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<assign type="addattribute">` names no attribute: `attr` is missing
notes: `type="addattribute"` adds an attribute to the selected element, so `attr` must name it; the value comes from `expr` or the child content
diagnostics.help: add `attr="name"` with the attribute to add

notes: only `type="addattribute"` adds an attribute named by `attr`; every other placement replaces or inserts nodes, so `attr` would be ignored
diagnostics.help: remove `attr`, or set `type="addattribute"` to add that attribute

notes: `<assign>` stores a value at `location`, taken from `expr` or from its child content; without either there is nothing to assign
diagnostics.help: add `expr` with the value to assign, or give the value as child content
